acceptable_use: Data is used for law enforcement purposes only. Data is owned by the Marysville Police Department and is never sold to 3rd parties.
prohibited_uses: Immigration enforcement, traffic enforcement, harassment or intimidation, usage based solely on a protected class (i.e. race, sex, religion), or personal use.
hotlist_policy: Hotlist hits (i.e., stolen vehicles, missing persons, etc.) are required to be human verified prior to action.

More Info
overview: The Marysville Police Department uses Flock Safety technology to capture objective evidence without compromising individual privacy. The Marysville Police Department uses retroactive searches to help generate case leads and solve crimes after they've occurred. Additionally, the Marysville Police Department utilizes real-time alerting of hotlist vehicles to capture wanted criminals who travel through our city to commit other crimes. To ensure proper usage and establish proper guardrails for the program, we have made the policies and usage statistics available to the public.
